command_metadata.name: prefs.info

command_metadata.description: Restore and focus the existing window
command_metadata.name: prefs.show

command_metadata.description: List the app's commands with labels, shortcuts and enablement
command_metadata.name: prefs.actions

command_metadata.name: prefs.execute

command_metadata.description: Close once the operation in progress finishes
command_metadata.name: prefs.quit

command_metadata.description: The page tree in sidebar order: each page's id, title, parent, icon, kind (list, sections, custom or pending) and missing backend, and the open page
command_metadata.name: prefs.pages

args.page: optional page id from prefs.pages; the open page when absent

command_metadata.description: One page as data: its sections and drawers, each row's control, settings key, value, whether it is shown, and why it takes no input (a missing backend, a pinned design source, a stale mirror); the store's role and revision
command_metadata.name: prefs.page

args.page: a page id from prefs.pages (COSMIC's kebab-case spelling also works)
args.row: optional row id from prefs.page: open its drawer and bring it into view

command_metadata.description: Open a page, as the sidebar, a sub-page row or a search hit does; closes search
command_metadata.name: prefs.page.open

args.key: the settings key of the control to operate (prefs.page names each row's key)
args.value: the new value; null resets the key

command_metadata.description: Operate the control bound to key exactly as a person would: refused when that control is disabled (a missing backend, a pinned design source, a stale mirror or an unreachable authority, each named), checked against settings.describe, then the control's own fenced settings.apply with its receipt. A key no page shows has no control in Preferences; write it with settings.apply
command_metadata.name: prefs.set

command_metadata.description: Press a live item's button (Connect, Forget, Remove) as a person would; refused while the page's backend is missing
command_metadata.name: prefs.item

command_metadata.description: Search every visible label (page titles and descriptions, section headings, row titles, descriptions and options) without changing the window; each hit names the page and the row it lands on
command_metadata.name: prefs.search

command_metadata.description: Select a section; optional group selects a group within Software
command_metadata.name: prefs.section

command_metadata.description: Open an app's Software group, select it and load its release notes
command_metadata.name: prefs.select

command_metadata.description: Software's rows, group, selection, notes, release_status and release_failed
command_metadata.name: prefs.apps

command_metadata.description: The Appearance panel: the session look settingsd holds (current), the unapplied edits (draft, and the axes edited), axes another writer changed under them (conflicts: nothing applies until appearance.keep or appearance.revert), what the window shows (including effective decorations and decorations_reason), the revision read, and whether an apply is in flight or uncertain
command_metadata.name: prefs.appearance

args.font_family: optional installed family name or null for Inter
args.mono_family: optional monospace family name or null for JetBrains Mono
args.scheme: optional scheme name (ocean, crimson, stone, forest, sunset, mono, pro, studio, classic, breeze, adwaita)
args.style: optional style (plain, pro, studio, classic, breeze, adwaita) or own for the scheme's own

command_metadata.description: Change the session appearance: a present key sets that axis, an absent one leaves it; every axis is checked first, then the change applies at once (fenced), or as soon as an apply in flight settles; prefs.appearance reports a held refusal or a conflict
command_metadata.name: prefs.appearance.set

args.answer: instead of open: "confirm" (the remove, reset or forget confirmation's confirm button) or "cancel" (close any dialog)

command_metadata.description: Open a dialog, close the open one, or answer it: confirm does what the confirmation's button does; answers {dialog}
command_metadata.name: prefs.dialog

args.caption_side: optional auto, left, center, right or null to follow the session
args.decorations: optional auto, csd, ssd or null to follow the session
args.mode: optional light, dark or null to follow the session
args.scheme: optional scheme name (ocean, crimson, stone, forest, sunset, mono, pro, studio, classic, breeze, adwaita) or null to follow the session
args.style: optional style (plain, pro, studio, classic, breeze, adwaita), own for the scheme's own, or null to follow the session

command_metadata.description: Choose the window's theme: a present key sets that axis, an absent one leaves it; answers the choice and the effective scheme, mode, decorations and decorations_reason
command_metadata.name: prefs.theme

command_metadata.description: Apps → Email: the email app's accounts (in tree order, each with default and has_password: true, false, or null when Email is not running), default_account and mail options as settingsd last held them, Email's state on the Bus, the selected account and its form, and any password or connect in progress; never a password
command_metadata.name: prefs.email

args.ca_path: add/update: absolute PEM path, or null for the system roots
args.id: the account (not for add; null for default clears it)
args.name: add/update: the label
args.op: add, update, remove, move, default or enable
args.path: instead of op: email.mail.page_size, email.mail.mark_read_on_open, email.mail.confirm_delete, email.mail.quote_on_reply or email.mail.reply_position ("above" or "below")
args.url: add/update: https:// JMAP base, no trailing slash

command_metadata.description: Change the email settings in settingsd at once, as the window would: one fenced settings.apply carrying the whole account list, with default_account in the same batch when the change touches it (removing the default clears it); remove goes through Email (email.account.remove, answered with Email's reply, MIGRATION_PENDING included) when it may be running, else straight to settingsd; every field is checked first and a refusal names it; add answers the new account's id
command_metadata.name: prefs.email.set

args.forget: optional true, instead of password: Email deletes the saved password (any account id, a removed one too)

command_metadata.description: Hand an account's password to the email app (email.account.password.set), or with forget:true have Email delete it (the only empty password sent), launching Email first when it is not on the Bus; answered once Email has. Preferences neither stores nor shows it, and settingsd never sees it
command_metadata.name: prefs.email.password

args.exact: optional bool: the label must equal it
args.label: optional substring
args.viewport: optional owned window name (for example macro-editor or compose-2), honoured by every drive command; omitted for the app window

args.viewport: optional owned window name (for example macro-editor or compose-2), honoured by every drive command; omitted for the app window

command_metadata.description: Type text into the focused widget. A multi-line field takes it verbatim; elsewhere a newline presses Enter
